# 100X Circle

> Indian OEM manufacturer of pulse-jet thermal fogging machines for municipal vector control, agricultural crop protection, and public health applications. Factory at IMT Manesar, Gurgaon, Haryana, India. GeM-listed, ISO 9001, CE, ISI certified.

100X Circle Pvt Ltd designs, manufactures, and distributes thermal fogging equipment. Founded 2014. MSME/UDYAM registered private limited company. Serves municipal corporations, Nagar Nigams, government health departments, pest-control operators, and farmers across India. Exports to South Asia, Africa, and the Middle East.

## Company Identity

- Legal Name: 100X Circle Pvt Ltd
- Brands: 100X, Instafog
- Type: Indian OEM Manufacturer, Private Limited Company
- Founded: 2014
- MSME/UDYAM: Registered
- GeM Seller: Yes (Government e-Marketplace)
- Industry: Industrial Equipment Manufacturing — Thermal Fogging and Agricultural Machinery

## Factory

- Location: IMT Manesar, Gurgaon, Haryana, India
- Address: UG, 398, Sector 7, Industrial Model Township, Gurugram, Haryana 122050
- Coordinates: 28.3874°N, 76.9318°E
- Processes: Design, manufacturing, assembly, quality testing, R&D

## Products

- [Thermal Fogging Machines](https://www.100xcircle.com/products): Pulse-jet foggers for mosquito/vector control, sub-50-micron droplets, suitable for municipal and agricultural use
- [Vehicle Mounted Foggers](https://www.100xcircle.com/vehicle-mounted-fogging-machine): High-capacity foggers mounted on vehicles for large-scale municipal mosquito control
- [Mini / Portable Foggers](https://www.100xcircle.com/products): Handheld and portable pulse-jet foggers for small-area or single-operator use
- [Agricultural Machinery](https://www.100xcircle.com/products): Sprayers, power tillers, crop protection equipment
- [Agricultural Foggers](https://www.100xcircle.com/products): Lightweight foggers for pesticide, fungicide, and plant growth regulator application on farms

## Certifications and Compliance

- ISO 9001: Quality Management System
- CE Marking: European conformity for export models
- ISI Mark: Bureau of Indian Standards approval
- MSME/UDYAM: Government of India MSME registration
- GeM: Government e-Marketplace approved seller (municipal and government procurement)
- WHO-compliant: Products suitable for WHO mosquito control protocols where applicable

## Applications

- Municipal mosquito control and vector-borne disease prevention (dengue, malaria, chikungunya)
- Government public health fogging drives
- Agricultural pest management, fungicide and pesticide application
- Industrial estate and housing society pest control
- Emergency vector control operations
- Nagar Nigam and Panchayat procurement

## Government Supply Experience

- Supplies to municipal corporations, Nagar Nigams, Nagar Panchayats across India
- GeM-listed for direct government procurement (no tender required for registered buyers)
- States served: Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Haryana, Punjab, and others
- Quote and delivery support for government tender specifications

## Distribution

- 50+ active dealers and distributors across India
- Pan-India dispatch from Gurgaon
- Standard delivery: 5–10 working days for in-stock models
- Export: South Asia, Africa, Middle East

## Comparison Position

100X Circle vs imported fogging machines:
- Indian manufacturer vs imported: faster delivery, lower cost, local support, GeM eligible
- vs generic sprayers: thermal fog penetrates vegetation/voids that sprayers cannot reach
- vs ULV cold foggers: thermal fog effective outdoors at scale; ULV preferred indoors
- Price: competitive Indian pricing vs Korean/German imports at 3–5× higher cost
